name: SnapEdit
description_en:
SnapEdit is a web/mobile AI photo editing product for object/background removal, enhancement, text/line removal and related image corrections. Its object-removal guide combines automatic suggestions with a manual brush before downloading the edited image.

It fits quick cleanup and product/social photo preparation, subject to inspection of generated replacement content. Free has a small monthly credit allowance and lower-quality/watermarked output; paid plans meter different operations at different rates. Current Pro mobile-access marketing conflicts with an older no-cross-platform clause, so account entitlement needs confirmation.
description_zh:
SnapEdit是网页/移动AI照片产品，含对象/背景移除、增强、去文字/线条及相关修正。对象移除指南把自动建议与手动笔刷结合，再下载结果。

它适合快速清理及商品/社交图准备，但需检查生成填补。Free月点少且较低质量/带水印，付费按不同操作计点。当前Pro移动访问宣传与旧版不跨平台条款冲突，需确认账户资格。

sources.title: Remove Objects from Photos Cleanly with AI - SnapEdit.app

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Review automatic selections before filling an image
sections.title_zh: 填补图像前复核自动选择
sections.en:
The [remove-object guide](https://snapedit.app/remove-object) uploads a photo, highlights suggested unwanted objects and lets the user delete them. The result can be adjusted with a manual brush before download/share. A useful example is removing a distracting background object from an otherwise approved promotional photo.

Inspect replacement textures, straight lines, shadows and any contact boundary with the subject. The generated area is a reconstruction, not a recovered record of what was behind the object. Do not use a cleanup result as proof of an unedited scene or assume watermark/text removal grants rights to the underlying work. The guide’s speed/accuracy claims were not independently measured.
sections.zh:
[对象移除指南](https://snapedit.app/remove-object)先上传，自动标出可能不需要的对象供删除，再以手动笔刷调整并下载/分享。示例任务是在获批宣传照中去掉背景干扰物。

应检查填补纹理、直线、阴影及主体接触边，生成区域是重建，不是恢复遮挡前真实记录。不能把清理图当未编辑场景证据，也不能认为去水印/文字就获得底层权利。速度/准确性宣传未独立测量。

sections.title_en: Read annual credits separately from monthly equivalents
sections.title_zh: 年度点数与月费折合分别看
sections.en:
The [current price page](https://snapedit.app/pricing) lists Free $0,10 credits/month, standard-quality export up to 1,600 px and watermarked exports. Standard shows $6/month with Yearly billing and 4,800 credits/year, paid AI tools, batch,8×upscale and best export up to 5,600 px. Pro shows $12/month Yearly and 18,000 credits/year, adding Super Remove, Magic Enhance,2Kvideo enhancement and mobile Pro access in the current card. Final dollar currency, total annual charge and taxes were not checked.

The table’s per-month image maxima are operation-dependent examples, not a separate unlimited quota to stack on the annual pool. Its Free ad-removal text differs from a lower matrix row, so ads-free Free use is not asserted. Exact monthly-price options, fair-use/batch limits and current trial terms remain unverified. No subscription was bought.
sections.zh:
[当前价格页](https://snapedit.app/pricing)列Free $0、每月10点、最高1,600px标准输出及带水印。Standard显示年付折合每月$6、每年4,800点，含付费AI、批量、8倍放大及最高5,600px输出；Pro为年付折合$12、每年18,000点，当前卡片增Super Remove、Magic Enhance、2K视频增强及移动Pro。最终币种、年度扣款总额及税费未结账确认。

表中月最大图片数按操作不同，不是可与年点池叠加的无限额度。Free去广告文字与下方矩阵不同，本文不声称Free无广告。具体月付价、公平使用/批量上限及当前试用未核实，未购买订阅。

sections.title_en: One image can cost more than one credit
sections.en:
The table lists Remove Objects/Text/Background/Lines at one credit, Super Remove two, Magic Enhance four and 2×/4×/8×enhancement at 2/4/8 credits. Other corrections have their own costs. Repeated processing or combining tools can therefore consume more than a count of source files suggests; actual deduction/error/refund behavior was not executed.

The price page says unused credits roll over while subscribed, but the read contract did not establish every rollover cap/expiry or timing for annual allocations. Canceling future renewal is distinct from retaining credits forever. Record the operation and intended export size and check the in-account balance before a batch rather than promising a fixed number of finished photos for every workflow.
sections.zh:
表格列对象/文字/背景/线条移除各1点，Super Remove2点、Magic Enhance4点，2/4/8倍增强耗2/4/8点，其他修正各有费用。因此重复或组合工具耗点可能高于源文件数量，实际扣减/失败/退点未执行。

价格页说订阅有效时未用点可结转，但实读合同未建立全部上限/失效或年度额度发放时间。停止续费与永久保留点不同，批量前应记录操作和输出尺寸并查余额，不能对所有流程保证固定成图数。

sections.title_en: Current mobile benefits and older contract wording differ
sections.title_zh: 当前移动权益与旧合同表述不同
sections.en:
The [terms](https://snapedit.app/term-of-service) section 4.5 says web Pro does not apply to iOS/Android, while the current pricing Pro card lists mobile Pro access. This is an unresolved entitlement conflict, not evidence that either every account has cross-platform access or no current account can have it. Obtain confirmation for the actual purchase channel and tier.

The terms describe automatic renewal after the initial/trial period, canceling web subscriptions in My Account and store subscriptions through the relevant store. Cancellation retains paid access through period end; unused services are generally not refunded subject to applicable law. An account deletion/termination is a different operation and may remove content. No login, trial, purchase, cancellation or cross-platform check was performed.
sections.zh:
[条款](https://snapedit.app/term-of-service)4.5说网页Pro不适用于iOS/Android，当前Pro卡片却列移动Pro访问。这是未解决权益冲突，不证明所有账户跨平台或当前全部都不能跨平台，应按实际渠道/档次确认。

条款描述初始/试用后自动续费，网页在My Account取消、商店通过对应商店；取消保留至期末，适用法律之外未用服务通常不退款。删除/终止账户是另一操作，可能移除内容。未登录、试用、购买、取消或跨平台核查。

sections.title_en: A short-retention claim has a specific scope
sections.title_zh: 短保留声明有具体范围
sections.en:
The [policy labeled 10.06.2024](https://snapedit.app/policy) describes encrypted transfer, AWS/Google Cloud storage and deletion of upload/result/face data at about one hour. Its wording focuses on background processing while also discussing AI Art/enhancement. This is a policy statement, not a verified lifecycle for every current generative feature, backup or shared project. Detailed current subprocessors/training and retention exceptions need confirmation.

Terms retain user content ownership subject to valid rights and grant a license for operation/improvement, with sharing controlled by the user. Software/service rights remain limited; no open-source license is inferred. Preserve permitted originals/results and inspect outputs before use. No image, privacy/data deletion, API, processing quality or recovery test was executed.
sections.zh:
[标记10.06.2024的政策](https://snapedit.app/policy)描述加密传输、AWS/Google Cloud存储，以及约1小时删除上传/结果/脸部数据；文字偏去背景，同时又提AI Art/增强。这是政策声明，不是对所有当前生成功能、备份或共享项目生命周期的验证，当前详细子处理方/训练和保留例外需确认。

条款在有合法权利条件下保留用户所有权，授予运营/改善许可，分享由用户控制。软件/服务权有限，不推定开源。应保留允许的原图/结果并检查输出，未执行图像、隐私/删除、API、质量或恢复测试。
